description: For complex or long-running tasks, Master must maintain a Goal Pursuit Ledger tracking goal anchor, progress, evidence, capability failures, review status, and completion verification.
triggerCondition: A task is complex, long-running, or involves multiple phases with dependencies.
expectedBehavior: Master must establish a Goal Anchor with trueGoal, userValue, nonGoals, successCriteria, and riskBoundary.
Master must maintain a Progress Ledger with currentPhase, completed, inProgress, blocked, and nextAction.
Master must track Evidence Ledger: readFiles, toolCalls, assumptions, and unavailableEvidence.
Master must disclose capability failures in CapabilityFailureDisclosure.
Master must track review mode and Counter-Agent status in ReviewLedger.
CompletionVerification must answer whether the original goal was achieved.
If any ledger check fails, finalStatus must be partial, blocked, or failed.
forbiddenBehavior: Declaring completion without checking Goal Anchor against results.
Recording completed work that has not passed verification.
Hiding capability failures from the ledger.
Treating internal reflection as equivalent to Counter-Agent review.
Setting finalStatus to completed when any ledger check is inconsistent.
